title: The conductor: the store's keepers run under the hood as a worker job, every run recorded, a failure never stopping the others
request: A conductor that runs the keepers (then the later tiers) under the hood, records each run, and never lets two keepers write one path.
plan: Keepers with claims; registration refused on an overlapping claim.
conduct(): each keeper a step of a harness session, one run record.
A worker job 'store', swept at most once an hour, off in tests.

decisions.decision: A whole run and a removal's one-workspace run are recorded apart.
decisions.why: Only a whole run resets the hourly clock; a removal must not postpone the next whole run.

change: dclab_rnd.store.conductor (conduct, failed, due, sweep_due), keepers (Claim, Keeper, Source, register), the job 'store' and its sweep, the harness agent 'conductor', DCLAB_STORE_LOOP.

findings.defect: The worker's hourly job kept nothing.
findings.scenario: The job ran conduct with an empty registry.
findings.cause: Nothing installed the keepers on the worker path.
findings.fix: conduct installs the keepers by default; the job passes its workspace.

findings.defect: One unreadable file stopped a keeper for the rest of the run.
findings.scenario: A draft's events made unreadable: every file after it was not kept, every run.
findings.cause: One try around the whole loop.
findings.fix: Each source on its own: its error kept as an entry, the rest go on.

findings.defect: The hourly run could be postponed forever, and a failed one retried every minute.
findings.scenario: Each removal's run reset the clock; a failure wrote no record.
findings.fix: Only whole runs count, and a failure is recorded.

outcome: The store's keepers run on their own once an hour, each run a harness session with its record, a failure of one source never stopping the rest.
lessons: Test the production path, not only the function: the job ran with no keepers while every unit test passed.
risks: The worker runs the conductor in its own thread: a very large workspace makes the run long.
